description: Huawei Cloud LTS (Log Tank Service) full lifecycle management via hcloud CLI. Covers log groups, log streams, indexes, transfer tasks, keyword/SQL alarm rules, and log search. Supports Query (list/show logs, alarms, transfers, indexes), Create (log groups/streams, indexes, transfers, alarms), Update (TTL, index, transfer, alarm config), Delete (log resources, alarm rules), and Diagnose (search logs to locate faults). Delete operations require explicit user confirmation; batch deletion of all LTS resources is prohibited. Triggers include: LTS, 云日志服务, log group, log stream, 日志组, 日志流, 日志检索, 日志转储, 日志告警, 索引配置, log transfer, log alarm, log index, 日志运维, 故障排查, log search, structured log, SQL alarm, keyword alarm.
